etymology: neuter of a compound of 1497 and a presumed derivative of 2380
avSummary: things offered unto idols 4, things offered in sacrifice to idols 3, things sacrificed unto idols 2, meats offered to idols 1
definition:
1) sacrificed to idols, the flesh left over from the heathen sacrifices
